title: Rise of the Gecko King
description: This is a mod that's in development, made for Geckocraft: The Beginning of the End.
body:
This is a mod that's in development, made for Geckocraft: The Beginning of the End.

So far, this mod adds the Gecko King (W.I.P.), the gecko warrior, the royal claw, the royal claw dagger, and a new music disc. Anything with W.I.P. beside its name will not be accessible without cheats.
Unfortunately, because the Gecko King is a work in progress, none of the items in this mod are obtainable.
Gecko warriors can be found in many of the overworld's biomes. They spawn more frequently in caves, and they get easier to find the deeper you are.

Anyways, more updates are coming out sometime soon.

Subscribe to my YouTube channel! https://www.youtube.com/@therealGecko_KingYT
